sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
INNER JOIN assays AS ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary AS td ON ass.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary AS md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures AS cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293197'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ass.assay_type = 'B'
  AND td.tid = ass.tid
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
